what_it_does: Buy contrarian weekly sell-offs when trading activity and independently observed Wikipedia information support a temporary liquidity-shock interpretation.
layers: index regime; attention + sentiment entry; next-open stop / weekly time exit
registration_location: local immutable log; not posted to shared sheet
holding_rule: First exit: close-based loss threshold or next weekly rebalance or five market sessions. A close trigger executes at the next tradable open. No intrabar stop-fill assumption. No new position if its planned exit is outside the split.
sizing: Inverse trailing 63-session volatility among selected stocks, capped at 10 percent per name at entry; unused capital stays cash. No leverage, no shorts. At most ten names. All positions close by the next weekly rebalance, so attention gates scale the entire new week's book.
costs: US Vibe GlobalEquityEngine: 10 bps execution slippage per side and zero extra commission. HK: Vibe HK slippage/commission/levy/settlement, date-dependent 0.1/0.13 percent duty plus whole-HKD ceiling. Current official lot snapshot is a disclosed historical-lot assumption. Cash return and risk-free rate are zero.
why_it_did_well_or_badly: HK had positive test IC and beat the HSI test Sharpe, but its train timing percentile was only 20.5%. US test IC turned negative and net Sharpe fell to 0.016. The hypothesized reversal was not stable across markets or periods.
ic_method: selection-oriented review v1; original exports retained; no portfolio rerun
